description: This file is a build script for preparing kernel images and modules for various Android kernel versions, using functions defined in an external script. It orchestrates the preparation of multiple kernel images and modules with specific versions and configurations.

methods.name: prepare_lz4
methods.description: Prepares compressed LZ4 images for kernels.

methods.name: prepare_kernel_image
methods.description: Prepares a kernel image with specified parameters such as version and architecture.

methods.name: prepare_kernel_modules
methods.description: Prepares kernel modules for a specific kernel version and architecture.
